problem_type: ephemeral single-shot prompt history isolation regression
symptom: The production direction planner's HTTP request includes prior resident Agent messages such as F_PLAN_DONE and F_VERIFY_LOW, so the direction model receives unrelated thread history and strict real-walk isolation evidence fails.
direct_cause: projectAgentExecutionHelpers.executionPrompt always prefixed snapshot.activeThreadId user/assistant items, even when the request capability was single-shot and its history envelope was ephemeral.
class_root: The Host used one prompt assembly path for two different caller semantics: resident multi-turn tasks need initiating-thread context, while single-shot direction and visual-judge tasks require a fresh prompt. The transport history marker alone cannot distinguish these because the Host queue also uses an ephemeral envelope for resident turns.
affected_population: Renderer-owned single-shot image and video shot verification requests
Any future single-shot capability routed through the ProjectAgent Host while a resident thread has prior items
entry_points: runDirectionPlanner and shotVerifyJudge enqueue capability=single-shot through runSingleShotAgent
ProjectAgent execution coordinator calls executionPrompt before runAgent
Resident ProjectAgent turns continue through the same helper with canvas-agent, creation-editor, storyboard, or timeline capability
internal_only_reason: Prompt history admission is an internal ProjectAgent Host contract; no model vendor controls which Nomi thread items may enter a single-shot request.
invariants: A single-shot capability receives exactly its current request prompt and never snapshot.activeThreadId prior messages.
Resident multi-turn capabilities retain initiating-thread prior context even when the Host transport envelope is ephemeral.
The fix is capability-based and does not infer isolation from a vendor, model, or prompt keyword.
generality_proof: All renderer single-shot callers use the shared runSingleShotAgent capability and all resident callers pass a different capability through the same execution coordinator. The helper branch therefore covers direction planning, shot verification, and future single-shot callers while preserving resident thread continuity.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Admit only the current prompt for single-shot requests and assemble initiating-thread context for resident multi-turn requests.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: It sends capability=single-shot through the shared runner, so executionPrompt now isolates it from the active resident thread.
The visual judge uses the same single-shot capability and receives no unrelated resident transcript.
Resident composer requests use surface capabilities such as canvas-agent and must retain the initiating thread context; the regression test pins that behavior.

recurrence.reason: Any new single-shot caller would otherwise inherit the active resident transcript through the shared execution helper.
same_class_scan: Searched runSingleShotAgent and executionPrompt callers; direction planning and shot verification are the current single-shot production paths.
Searched resident runWorkbenchAgent capability assignments; resident turns use non-single-shot capabilities and rely on thread continuity.
Added paired helper regressions for single-shot isolation and resident multi-turn retention so a future branch cannot broaden isolation globally.

prevention.invariant: executionPrompt branches on the canonical AgentChatCapability before reading activeThreadId prior items.
prevention.failure_mode: A regression test fails if single-shot receives prior text or if resident multi-turn loses prior context.
prevention.strategy: Use the capability contract as the caller semantic discriminator at the shared Host prompt boundary; do not add vendor-specific or keyword-based exclusions.

legacy_paths.rationale: No renderer-owned history path is restored; the existing Host prompt boundary remains the sole owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The repair changes no third-party dependency or runtime lifecycle.

migration: No persisted data migration is needed. Existing Host items remain durable for UI receipts, while future single-shot model requests stop projecting those items into their prompt.
residual_risks: The focused helper tests prove the prompt boundary; the real Electron walk must still verify direction request isolation and subsequent script/preview/export stages.
Resident context continuity remains dependent on the Host active thread and is intentionally covered by the paired non-single-shot test.
